addonAfter.zh-CN: 后置标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 JSX 元素。
addonAfter.en-US: Addon after the input: text, a Semi icon or any JSX element.

addonBefore.zh-CN: 前置标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 JSX 元素。
addonBefore.en-US: Addon before the input: text, a Semi icon or any JSX element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when showClear is true.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 onChange，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; onChange does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the input is uncontrolled.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。未设置时使用所在 InputGroup 的 disabled。
disabled.en-US: Whether the input is disabled. When not set, the disabled of the InputGroup it is in applies.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxLength、minLength 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxLength and minLength.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

inputRef.zh-CN: 接收原生 input 元素。

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 input 元素的样式，对象键使用 kebab-case，数值需带单位。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the native input element; object keys are kebab-case and numbers need a unit.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，未设置 prefix 时渲染在前缀位置；此时若未设置 aria-label 与 aria-labelledby，输入框通过 aria-labelledby 由它命名。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label rendered in the prefix position when no prefix is set; then, if neither aria-label nor aria-labelledby is set, the input is named by it through aria-labelledby.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 所在元素的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the element around insetLabel, for aria-labelledby to reference.

maxLength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxLength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minLength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minLength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

mode.zh-CN: 输入框模式，可选 password，显示密码显隐按钮。
mode.en-US: Input mode; password shows a button that reveals or hides the text.

onBlur.zh-CN: 输入框失去焦点时的回调。监听在外层容器上，焦点在输入框与组件内按钮之间移动时不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the input. It listens on the wrapper, so focus moving between the input and the buttons inside the component does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 输入内容变化时的回调，参数为新值与事件。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes, with the new value and the event.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时的回调（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不触发。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called on Enter keydown; the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 输入框获得焦点时的回调。监听在外层容器上，组件内部的焦点移动不会再次触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the input gets focus. It listens on the wrapper, so focus moving inside the component does not fire it again.

onlyBorder.zh-CN: 外层容器的边框宽度，单位 px。
onlyBorder.en-US: The border width of the wrapper, in px.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the input is empty.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的 focus 调用。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus calls inside the component.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 JSX 元素。
prefix.en-US: Prefix: text, a Semi icon or any JSX element.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读：禁止输入，且不显示清除按钮。原生 readOnly 只禁止输入。
readonly.en-US: Read-only: blocks typing and hides the clear button. The native readOnly only blocks typing.

ref.zh-CN: 接收外层容器 div 元素，其 `focus()` 与 `blur()` 作用于输入框。
ref.en-US: Receives the wrapper div element; its `focus()` and `blur()` act on the input.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the input has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

showClearIgnoreDisabled.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 DatePicker 使用：禁用时仍可清除。
showClearIgnoreDisabled.en-US: Internal property used by DatePicker: the clear button stays available while disabled.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 large、default、small。在 InputGroup 中未设置时取组的 size。
size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small. In an InputGroup it takes the size of the group when not set.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 JSX 元素。
suffix.en-US: Suffix: text, a Semi icon or any JSX element.

type.en-US: The type of the native input.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

value.zh-CN: 输入框内容，受控使用，配合 onChange 更新。
value.en-US: Content of the input, used as a controlled value together with onChange.

autosize.zh-CN: 高度是否随内容自适应，可传 `{ minRows, maxRows }` 限制行数。
autosize.en-US: Whether the height follows the content; pass `{ minRows, maxRows }` to limit the rows.

cols.zh-CN: 默认列数，按平均字符宽度计。
cols.en-US: Visible width in average character widths.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 onChange，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; onChange does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the text area is uncontrolled.

disabled.en-US: Whether the text area is disabled.

disabledEnterStartNewLine.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 Chat 使用：Enter 不换行，Shift + Enter 换行。
disabledEnterStartNewLine.en-US: Internal property used by Chat: Enter does not start a new line, Shift + Enter does.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxLength、minLength、maxCount 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxLength, minLength and maxCount.

lineNumberClassName.en-US: Class name of the line number area.

lineNumberStyle.zh-CN: 行号区域的样式，对象键使用 kebab-case，数值需带单位。
lineNumberStyle.en-US: Style of the line number area; object keys are kebab-case and numbers need a unit.

maxCount.zh-CN: 字数上限，设置后显示字数统计；超出时计数器标红，不截断输入。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of characters; setting it shows a counter, which turns red when exceeded. The input is not truncated.

maxLength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxLength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minLength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minLength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

onBlur.zh-CN: 失去焦点时的回调。监听在外层容器上，焦点在文本框与清除按钮之间移动时不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the text area. It listens on the wrapper, so focus moving between the text area and the clear button does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 文本内容变化时的回调，参数为新值与事件。
onChange.en-US: Called when the text changes, with the new value and the event.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时的回调（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不触发。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called on Enter keydown; the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 获得焦点时的回调。监听在外层容器上，组件内部的焦点移动不会再次触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the text area gets focus. It listens on the wrapper, so focus moving inside the component does not fire it again.

onResize.zh-CN: 尺寸变化回调：autosize 导致高度变化时触发；用户拖拽 resize 调整尺寸时也会触发，并额外给出 width。
onResize.en-US: Called when the size changes: when autosize changes the height, and when the user drags the resize handle, which also provides width.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读：禁止输入，且不显示清除按钮。原生 readOnly 只禁止输入。
readonly.en-US: Read-only: blocks typing and hides the clear button. The native readOnly only blocks typing.

ref.zh-CN: 接收外层容器 div 元素，其 `focus()` 与 `blur()` 作用于文本框。
ref.en-US: Receives the wrapper div element; its `focus()` and `blur()` act on the textarea.

resize.zh-CN: 是否允许拖拽调整尺寸及方向，可选 none、both、horizontal、vertical、block、inline；仅在显式传入时生效，autosize 开启时忽略。
resize.en-US: Whether and in which direction the user may resize: none, both, horizontal, vertical, block or inline. It only takes effect when given and is ignored with autosize.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the text area has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

showCounter.zh-CN: 是否显示字数统计；设置 maxCount 时总是显示。
showCounter.en-US: Whether to show the counter; it is always shown when maxCount is set.

textareaRef.zh-CN: 接收原生 textarea 元素；showLineNumber 切换时 textarea 会重新挂载，并再次调用。
textareaRef.en-US: Receives the native textarea element; showLineNumber remounts the textarea, so it is called again with the new element.

textareaStyle.zh-CN: 内部 textarea 元素的样式，如高度；对象键使用 kebab-case，数值需带单位。
textareaStyle.en-US: Style of the inner textarea element, such as its height; object keys are kebab-case and numbers need a unit.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

value.zh-CN: 文本内容，受控使用，配合 onChange 更新。
value.en-US: Text content, used as a controlled value together with onChange.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，组内任意深度未自行设置 disabled 的控件取这个值。
disabled.en-US: Whether the group is disabled; controls at any depth in the group that set no disabled of their own take it.

label.zh-CN: 组的标签，对象形式，属性同 Form.Label（如 text、required、extra）；text 可以是 JSX 元素。
label.en-US: Label of the group, as an object with the Form.Label props such as text, required and extra; text can be a JSX element.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 标签位置，可选 top 或 left。

onBlur.zh-CN: 组内任一控件失去焦点时的回调，组内控件之间移动焦点也会触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when any control in the group loses focus, including a move to another control in it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组内任一控件获得焦点时的回调，组内控件之间移动焦点也会触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when any control in the group gets focus, including a move from another control in it.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 large、default、small；组内任意深度未自行设置 size 的控件取这个值。
size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small; controls at any depth in the group that set no size of their own take it.
